_: Juice (PLAN.md, Phase 1; Kingdom Two Crowns' coin drop, Into the Breach's instant reply): every order answered at the click, the treasury counted down, the seal pressed, music that follows the realm's tension. coins_seconds: how long the treasury counts to its new sum. seal_punch: how big the spent seal's pip swells. music_tension_above: the realm's tension (bridge director.js, 0 calm to 1 on fire) above which the music turns dark; music_calm_below: below which it settles again.

speed._: + and - (main.gd _step_speed): steps are the seconds a season lasts, slowest first (the bridge holds them within pace.json's fastest and slowest); words: what the King hears at each step; at either end the same word again.

settings._: Settings' game section (title.gd _game_settings; Total War: Warhammer III's Game tab): head; size and sizes [label, interface scale] (main.gd ui_scale, 0.6..1.8); speed and speeds, one name per speed.steps entry; cam and cams [label, camera speed] (settings camera_speed, camera_rig.gd _speed).
settings.head: The game
settings.size: Size of the words on screen

no_host: The King has no host in the field.
